name: Messiah
source:
A second-year student at High School A, located near Shibuya. She's been close friends with Memory since they were in elementary school. Although you wouldn't expect it from her eye-catching fashion choices, she's a diligent and caring person who often finds herself being dragged around by the forgetful Memory. 

Because of her kind nature, she frequently hides her true feelings out of consideration for others. She loves cute, trendy things and checks the internet daily to stay on top of things. Before high school, she was a plain, ordinary girl who wore long skirts and kept her hair naturally black. She was obsessed with anime and manga, but upon discovering a stylish and inspiring internet idol. That motivated her to study fashion, and she made her high school debut as you see her now.
[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2943040]Steam[/url]]
